activity.title: Activity
activity.always: Always use this category for transactions containing:
activity.newBillHelp: Filled in from this payment. Choose how often it repeats; payments with the same bank text are linked to the bill from now on.

plan.title: Plan
plan.incomeHelp: What comes in each month. The first salary to arrive starts the budget month; the others are the second influx. Anything paid from the 24th on counts for the next month. Until a salary arrives, the expected amount counts.
plan.billsHelp: Fixed costs, set aside up front. A bank payment containing the match text marks the bill paid. Totals are per month: a yearly 600 zł counts as 50 zł.
plan.goalsHelp: The monthly amount is set aside until the goal is reached.
plan.budgetsHelp: Optional monthly limits per category. You'll see when one runs out.
plan.rulesHelp: Transactions containing the text go to the category automatically.
plan.name: Name
plan.matchHelp: Part of the bank description or recipient, e.g. "orange" or "czynsz".
plan.ruleIncomplete: Fill in the text and the category.
plan.startsMonth: Payday: its arrival can start the budget month
plan.startsMonthHelp: Turn off for smaller regular transfers in that shouldn't move the month.
plan.spreadHelp: So the month it renews isn't a shock.
plan.matchFound: No other payments contain this text yet. | 1 other payment contains this text; it will be linked too. | {n} other payments contain this text; they will be linked too.

kindHelp.transfer: Moving money between our own accounts. Never counted.
kindHelp.savings: Putting money aside. Covered by the goals line, not counted as spending.

banks.title: Banks
banks.synced: Up to date. | 1 new transaction. | {n} new transactions.
banks.inPocketHelp: Count this account's money in the pocket (turn off for savings accounts).
banks.privacy: Bank access goes through Enable Banking, a licensed PSD2 provider. It is read-only: the app can see balances and transactions, never move money. Banks ask you to renew access every 180 days at most.

callback.missing: The bank didn't send an approval back.
callback.accounts: No accounts found. | 1 account added. | {n} accounts added.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startDay: Usual first day of the budget month
settings.startDayHelp: Only used until you add salaries in Plan. After that, each month starts with the first salary to arrive.
settings.invitesHelp: An invite link lets one person join and expires after 7 days.

payday.button: Salary not picked up? Mark payday
payday.title: Payday
payday.intro: Normally the month starts by itself when a salary arrives (set the bank text to match in Plan). Use this if a salary wasn't matched, or there's no bank sync for it.
payday.preview: This month will run {start} – {end}, instead of starting on {usual}.
payday.already: This month already started on {date}, when {by} pressed Payday. Pressing again won't start another month.
payday.alreadyThatDay: Already done: {by} pressed Payday for this day.
payday.movePreview: Moving it makes the month run {start} – {end}.
payday.alreadySalary: This month already started on {date}, when {income} arrived.
